text:
tara: Quick micro-review request  final blog draft for Product X is in preview. Need short thumbs on hero line, benchmark phrasing, and CTA UTMs. Target publish Mon 9am PT.

leo: On it. Link?

tara: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/1761234567  focus on hero, benchmark callout, and webinar CTA behavior.

anya: Hero suggestion: 'Engineered inference, predictable latency'  clean and technical. Could also be 'Predictable inference at scale'.

frank: Benchmark line idea: 'In Dedicated tests, workloads sustained high token throughput while keeping median latency near 100ms on representative prompts.' Add a parenthetical for test kit.

marta: Agree with parenthetical. Proposed parenthetical: '(test config: 4xH100, seq_len=256, mixed-batch eval)'. Keep it collapsed on mobile.

leo: Legal/product ask: soften 'near 100ms' to 'typically near 100ms' to avoid absolutes.

anya: Updated phrasing: 'median latency typically near 100ms' + parenthetical.

ops-bot: UTM suggestion: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=prodx_launch_apr2026. HubSpot hidden fields: campaign=prodx_launch_apr2026, lead_source=blog, interest=dedicated. Recommend server-side tag 'prodx_launch_apr2026' for direct CTA clicks.

frank: CTA copy: top button 'See Product X in action' (webinar) and bottom 'Get started' (trial). Use separate UTMs per button.

leo: Also add privacy checkbox/line by webinar form: 'We process personal data according to our Privacy Policy.'

marta: Can we include a tiny placeholder quote block for layout? e.g., "Redwood helped us lower latency and simplify deployment"  placeholder.

tara: Added placeholder. Pushed edits to preview. Preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/1761234567.

ops-bot: Reminder: implement server-side tagging for direct CTA clicks and ensure HubSpot form maps hidden fields. I'll coordinate infra webhook for webinar signups to notify Sales Ops.

legal: Quick flag: avoid comparative language vs competitors and absolute guarantees. 'Typically' and the test parenthetical look good. I can do a 15-min final pass once you freeze copy.

tara: Great. Plan: freeze copy in 60m, legal pass, ops to wire UTMs and server-tags, schedule publish Mon 9am PT. Thanks all! :tada:
